decisions.reason: Although the online portal is farther from the firm's paper-display core and only lightly publicized, management is likely to give this recent digital initiative more time because it supports deeper customer collaboration and information-security ambitions.

This award-winning cardboard packaging display solution is close to the firm's capabilities, publicly validated, and aligned with its broader 3D cardboard direction, so management has very little reason to withdraw it.

The quarter-pallet cardboard pegboard display sits squarely in the established offer and has visible website commitment, which makes management inclined to persist through any early-market uncertainty.
The small cardboard counter display is a straightforward extension of the firm's core display range, so sunk development and recent launch timing favor keeping it on the market.

The large freestanding cardboard information display fits the core portfolio and announced expansion in 3D cardboard solutions, so management is likely to continue backing it unless results turn clearly weak.
